entries.text: It takes several hours, but you fix the power generator. With the power restored, and the gangs gone, the townspeople are grateful. They give you some valuable information. Your task in Scrapheap is done. The mission to find the water chip still awaits.

It takes several hours, but you fix the power generator. With the power restored, and the gangs gone,
 the townspeople are grateful. They give you some valuable information. Your task in Scrapheap is done. The
 mission to find the water chip still awaits.

entries.text: You cannot fix the generator. The people of Scrapheap will lead a poorer life without their power; but with the gangs gone, at least they will have a life. Your task in Scrapheap is done. The mission to find the water chip still awaits.
Further tampering with the generator yields nothing.
